### Install

1. Download `macOS.Cleaner_<version>_universal.dmg` below (works on Apple Silicon and Intel Macs).
2. Open it and drag **macOS Cleaner** to **Applications**.
3. The app is not signed by Apple yet, so macOS blocks the first launch. Open it once, then go to
   **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**. Alternatively, run
   `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/macOS Cleaner.app"` in Terminal.
4. Grant **Full Disk Access** when asked, so the scan can see every folder.

To uninstall, use **Settings → Uninstall macOS Cleaner** inside the app.
